question: Shovana Narayan has been honoured with the Padma Shri for her contribution to which Indian dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shovana Narayan** has been honoured with the **Padma Shri** for her contribution to the Indian dance form **Kathak**.
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
